transcript:
User: Hey. Got something in the mail about missed calls?
Agent: Hey! Yeah, that sounds like us—Dialux helps small businesses with missed calls and after‑hours callers.

What kind of business are you running, and what’s been happening with your calls lately?
User: Already told ya - me and my sister run Bright Smile Orthodontics up in Scottsdale. Our front desk keeps missing calls.
Agent: Got it, Bright Smile Orthodontics in Scottsdale with you and your sister—that helps me picture it.

When are those missed calls hurting you the most—during your daytime rush, or more in early morning/late afternoon when patients try to reschedule?
User: Already told ya - our front desk keeps missing calls. Mornings before my first patient are really the only good window.
Agent: Gotcha—mornings before your first patient are your best window. That’s helpful.

I don’t think I caught your name yet—what should I call you?
User: Already told ya - Dana Whitaker.
Agent: Thanks, Dana Whitaker.

Since you’re up in Scottsdale, are you on Mountain Time there most of the year?
User: Already told ya - we're Arizona, so like Mountain time I guess?
Agent: Perfect, Arizona / Mountain time, got it.

If Dialux had been picking up those missed calls last week, what kind of calls do you wish we’d captured—new patients, reschedules, emergencies?
User: Hm, hadn't thought about it - whatever works for you guys.
Agent: Totally fair answer.

Since you’re getting mail from us, we usually offer a quick callback to walk through how it would work for your office. What’s the best email and phone number to reach you on?
User: Already told ya - email's dana@brightsmileortho.com and this cell you're on is fine, it's my best number actually.
Agent: Nice, thanks Dana—that’s exactly what I needed.

I’ve got your name, Bright Smile Orthodontics in Scottsdale, email, best number, your Arizona time zone, and that mornings before your first patient are best. I have everything I need on my side.
User: Great, glad that’s settled! Looking forward to seeing how you can help with those missed calls. Let me know when you’re ready to chat.
Agent: Thanks so much, Dana. Your dedicated Dialux specialist will give you a call on this number, in your time zone, on a morning before your first patient to talk through handling those missed calls. Appreciate your time today—have a great rest of your day, and we’ll talk soon. Bye for now.
